prompt: Run browser QA for the Kolibri Agent Ops frontend. Do not modify source files. Verify desktop and mobile navigation, Overview, Agents, Tasks, Servers, Reports, Chat, Docs, Search, loading/degraded states, console errors, and visible layout overlap. Return screenshots or artifact paths when available.

quality_contract.objective: Verify the Agent Ops frontend visually and functionally before Codex accepts it.
quality_contract.context: UI changes must be checked in browser-like conditions across desktop and mobile viewports.
scope: Run build and lint if dependencies are available.
Check main navigation and core screens at desktop and mobile sizes.
Capture console errors, screenshots, and layout overlap findings.
out_of_scope: Do not edit files, deploy, restart services, or contact paid systems.
Do not read secrets, auth files, .env files, .ssh, or .mimocode.
Do not approve merge; Codex remains final reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: Return pass/fail per screen and viewport.
Report console errors and missing browser dependencies as explicit blockers.
Attach artifact paths or state why screenshots were not possible.
verification_steps: Run browser smoke coverage for desktop and mobile if supported.
deliverables: Structured result with status, summary, changed_files, checks, risks, and artifacts.
Browser QA report with blockers and polish notes.
stop_conditions: Stop if credentials, tokens, private keys, or auth file contents are required.
Stop if browser QA would require writing outside allowed_paths.
